title: Information Artifact
rationale: Retain the documentary comparison. Riskium adds continuity across descriptions and issued versions; the revised typing rationale separates documentary institution from RiskCase approval. No universal admission rule follows.

title: Artifact Version
rationale: Retain the distinction: the issued version is the documentary object; Revision qualifies a derivation. First issue need not revise a predecessor. Issuance policy does not determine whether a RiskCase exists.

title: Person
rationale: Retain a human-agent comparison without adopting external identity or typing axioms. Riskium preserves the person identity owned by the external domain; participation and a responsibility mandate need separate evidence.

title: Organization
rationale: Retain an institutional-agent comparison. Capacity to carry responsibilities is distinct from a demonstrated mandate. Organization identity does not require local register approval of every analytical RiskCase.

title: Evidence Item
rationale: Retain the external comparison and separately document the role foundation. EvidenceItem inherits artifact identity; RE-001 makes participation depend on grounded use. It does not classify every artifact as evidence everywhere.

title: Risk Case
rationale: Replace the old scoped absence label with an explicit comparison boundary. RiskCase is the continuing analytical item for objectives and context, including threat or opportunity perspectives. A generic Entity comparison does not supply its continuity rule. Register admission remains a local application policy. This disposition makes no novelty or universal absence claim.

title: Evidence Use Relator
rationale: Use an analogy to provenance usage while preserving the different participant structure. Riskium objectifies a grounded use linking a qualified reference and an evidence artifact, with context and purpose. RE-001 and RE-002 mediate the participants; RE-003 records grounding. OntoUML C2 supplies a minimum-count rule; distinct participants are an additional Riskium C-26 commitment, not a conclusion from that sum.

title: Evidence Reference Role
rationale: Distinguish a function description from the documentary reference that participates in grounded use. GE-001 preserves reference identity through EvidenceReference and InformationArtifact; RE-002 supplies the role dependency. The reference can exist as a record of proposed use without this role membership.
